title: Approximating the Fourier Transform from Non-equispaced Discrete Samples
summary: We study the approximation of the Fourier transform of a function from finitely many samples. Departing from the equispaced setting, we sample the function at deterministic non-equispaced nodes obtained by transforming equispaced points on $[0,1]$ through the inverse cumulative distribution function of a probability density. This change of variables compactifies the real line, so that no truncation of the space domain is necessary.
